failing_tests.detail: In resolve_agora_user_scope (services/control-plane/bff/agora/identity/scope.py), candidate tenant resolution evaluated _first_nonblank(*claim_tenants, default_match, ...) placing token claim tenants ahead of the authorized environment default tenant (default_match). This broke the precedence contract where configured active environment tenant overrides take precedence when within the caller's authorized tenant scope.

is_strict evaluated to True whenever bff_auth_mode() == 'strict' (the default when PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_MODE is unset), causing unauthenticated in-memory test identities without tokens or claims to have allowed_tenants set to [] rather than inheriting configured environment tenant defaults. Consequently, legitimate own-tenant writes failed closed with 403 AGORA_SCOPE_TENANT_DENIED instead of succeeding with 201.
